# winrt-Microsoft.WindowsAppSDK.Widgets

**IMPORTANT**: Windows App SDK packages cannot be used without the Windows App
Runtime. This has to be installed manually by the end user. Read the
[PyWinRT Windows App SDK documentation](https://pywinrt.readthedocs.io/en/latest/api/microsoft.html)
for more information.

Windows Runtime (WinRT) APIs for 4 namespaces.

This package provides the following modules:

- `winrt.microsoft.windows.widgets`
- `winrt.microsoft.windows.widgets.feeds.providers`
- `winrt.microsoft.windows.widgets.notifications`
- `winrt.microsoft.windows.widgets.providers`

The WinRT APIs in it are those of version 2.5.1 of the
`Microsoft.WindowsAppSDK` NuGet package.

Its metadata comes from the `Microsoft.WindowsAppSDK.Widgets` component,
version 2.0.5.
